newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks seen starting firm on strong dollar.
newsitem.headline: French stocks seen starting firm on strong dollar.

text.p: French stocks were expected to open with support from continuing strength in the dollar, which boosted the CAC index to a record closing high last Friday, traders said.
Volume averaged around 10 billion francs per day last week, giving solid support for the market rise, one broker said.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed on Friday up 52.41 points or 1.76 percent at 3,025.94. The CAC-40 futures contract on GLOBEX was up nine at 3,037 from Friday's close.
* Pinault-Printemps-Redoute posted H1 sales at 40.94 billion francs, seen as "good," a broker said.
* Bic share split on a two-for-one basis comes into effect today.
